description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the Recent Sequence Ratio and two metrics: Perplexity and GPU Memory Ratio. The x-axis represents the Recent Sequence Ratio, ranging from 0 to 100% with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of 20%. The left y-axis represents Perplexity, with a linear scale, ranging from 4.2 to 4.7, and tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The right y-axis represents the GPU Memory Ratio, also with a linear scale, ranging from 40 to 100%, and tick labels at intervals of 10%. The plot displays four lines: Perplexity (orange, solid, circle markers), Full Cache PPL (red, dashed), GPU Memory Ratio (blue, solid, circle markers), and Full Cache GPU Memory (blue, dashed). The Perplexity line starts at approximately 4.62 at 0% Recent Sequence Ratio, decreases to around 4.29 at 40%, slightly increases to about 4.34 at 80%, and then decreases again to approximately 4.33 at 100%. The GPU Memory Ratio line begins at around 39% at 0% Recent Sequence Ratio, gradually increases to about 50% at 60%, and then sharply rises to nearly 100% at 100%. The Full Cache PPL and Full Cache GPU Memory lines remain constant at approximately 4.41 and 60%, respectively, across the entire range of Recent Sequence Ratio.
